_meta.method: app pixel sizes read with PIL; OneDrive originals found by content (normalised 64-px grey signature, centre-cropped to the app image aspect; matchD < 0.1 = same picture, the runner-up is typically > 0.2). Only the שיווק folder was searched.
_meta.layout:
public/media mirrors assets/web: "assets/web/

" -> "../

" (src). Paths are relative to the public/ root (Vite serves them at BASE_URL + src). public/media/ is gitignored - run `node tools/copy-media.mjs` after a fresh checkout.
_meta.notCopied: apt/*.glb (unusable normalised lumps) and every OneDrive-relative path (higherRes / original / NotInApp / extraAngles / architectPng / facadeOriginals / portraitRendersOriginals): those live only in the owner's OneDrive marketing folder.

existing3dTour.what: Kolor Panotour / krpano 360-degree panorama tour titled "Kountouriotou 161" (author meta "Ivan Nov"), framed in harbour.html #location (.gr-map iframe) and the Piraeus map modal. Panoramas, not a mesh - nothing to reuse as geometry.

glbAssessment: All four are one node "Mesh_0", one primitive, one material "Material_0" (baseColor + normal + metallicRoughness + emissive, all 2048x2048, the normal map a 6.7-7.7 MB PNG), ~144-150k triangles, no extensions, no compression (Draco/meshopt/KTX2 absent), exported by Blender glTF I/O 4.4.55.

Scale is normalised, not metric: the longest horizontal extent of every file is 1.909-1.912 units (about -0.957..+0.955 on its long axis), whatever the apartment - the signature of an image-to-3D generator re-exported through Blender. Height 0.30-0.51 units.

Rendered headless with the app's own model-viewer (evidence/B1-glb-modelviewer.png): B1.glb is a lumpy photogrammetry-style reconstruction of the apt/B1.png picture (same invented bedroom/dining layout, baked lighting, wavy walls), not of the real 27.35 m2 studio.

Verdict: not usable as accurate per-apartment dollhouses (wrong layout, arbitrary scale, single baked mesh with no rooms/walls to pick or highlight, 16-19 MB each, only 4 types for 19 units). At most a decorative "mood" object; the 3D floor plans should be extruded from the architect vectors instead.
